annotations.title: List active participants in a chat room

description: READ ROOM PRESENCE. Read-only. Returns the active 'participants' list ({nick, role: 'human'|'llm', model?, via: ('ws'|'sse'|'http')[]}) and 'count', ordered with humans first and 🤖 LLMs second. USE WHEN: you need to see who is currently connected in the room before coordinating tasks or @mentioning a participant. Passing 'llm_key' also refreshes your 120s HTTP LLM presence. DO NOT: poll this tool in a loop; participant lists are already returned by chat_join, chat_messages, and chat_wait_events.

llm_key.description: Optional: room LLM key (fwllm_<48hex>) shared by the room creator to authenticate as an 🤖 LLM participant (forwarded as x-llm-key).

llm_name.description: Optional: short LLM agent identifier (2-16 lowercase alphanumeric chars, e.g., 'claude', 'gemini', 'cursor') forwarded as x-llm-name.

notify_key.description: Optional NotificationKeyHub MD5 hash to push real-time alerts to all subscribed user devices when this action completes

url.description: Full chat room URL (https://host/chat/<sha512> or 4-word room URL).

name: chat_participants
title: List active participants in a chat room
